title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Fullworks…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Fullworks Display Eventbrite Events plugin (widget-for-eventbrite-api) up to version 6.9.1. This vulnerability results from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in users' browsers.
